name: issue_1208_return_home_warm_day_restores_comfort
description: Issue #1208: warm day (classifier derives hvac_mode=off, comfort band armed). User leaves and the away setback is held; on returning at 14:00 the comfort ceiling must be restored on arrival, not up to 30 minutes later when the next classification cycle runs. Currently FAILS on production: the occupant who comes home to a warm house still has the 80F away ceiling until the 14:30 cycle.
notes: Reproduces Issue #1208 (bug-reproducing scenario, expected to FAIL until production is fixed; verdict.type=negative so simulate.py reports EXPECTED FAIL).

Occupant outcome: the occupant returns home on a warm afternoon and the thermostat still holds the away setback ceiling (80F) instead of the comfort ceiling (75F), so the home stays warm until the next 30-minute classification cycle.
Two assertions: (1) at 14:00 the arrival must restore comfort (comfort_restored, 75F); (2) at 14:30 the armed band ceiling must equal comfort_cool (75F).
Before Issue #85, apply_classification() would overwrite away setback with comfort temps every 30 minutes; this scenario's earlier steps (10:00/10:30 setback held) still verify that fix.
Promote to golden/ once Issue #1208 is fixed and this scenario passes.
